skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the relationship between natural resources and the economy, and the theoretical foundations of natural resource economics including market supply and demand, optimal resource use, and sustainability.
Identify and analyze policy issues related to natural resource management and propose solutions.
Apply critical thinking to solve economic problems in the allocation, exploitation, and use of natural resources.
Analyze market dynamics and economic efficiency in the context of natural resource management.
Understand and apply principles of sustainable resource use and management.
Conduct research and analyze data related to natural resource economics.
Effectively present research findings and solutions to natural resource management issues.
Work effectively in teams to solve complex problems related to natural resource management.
Make ethical decisions in the context of natural resource management and policy.
